content:
Apple today brought a number of major Mac announcements, including brand new Mac Studio and Mac mini product lines.

If you want to get your hands on the new products Apple announced today, you can now pre-order them on Amazon.

What's new today?

Here's our roundup to quickly get you up to speed on the Mac Studio and Mac mini updates. New chips (M6 and M5 Ultra) with more performance, new configuration options, plenty of new AI optimizations, and more.

  • Apple unveils new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro chips
  • Apple unveils new Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra
  • Apple unveils new Apple Silicon chips: M6 and M5 Ultra

Buy at Amazon

Following this morning's announcements, Amazon has started taking orders for Apple's new Mac minis and accessories.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple also made a small change to the Magic Keyboard today, with new models now available on Amazon:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID $149
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad (Black) $199

Buy at Best Buy

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,599

Are you planning to buy any of Apple's new products? Let us know in the comments.
